name: Aoshima Yurika
source:
The brains of the Pure Knight, who wields water abilities.
In her private life, she is a beautiful girl who works hard in student council activities. She has a strong sense of responsibility and fights against the evil organization, but when she meets the main character, her mission and loyalties changed drastically.
